claim_boundary.reason: This is a pre-registered protocol. It contains no local holdout results, no accepted release-gate attestation, and no production authorization.

leakage_controls: No holdout row may be used for feature selection, calibration, threshold tuning, or release-gate floor selection.
No source_ref SHA-256 digest may appear in both training/calibration evidence and independent_himalayan_holdout evidence.
Holdout dates and warning-region identifiers must be reported explicitly before evaluation.
Any four-class danger mapping must include reviewed mapping notes from the original five-level label.
Remote-sensing scenes used for model or threshold selection cannot be reused as fresh final holdout evidence.
objective: Pre-register the independent Himalayan holdout split, leakage controls, metrics, acceptance floors, and reporting outputs before any local model selection or public accuracy claim.

standards_anchors.name: RAvaFcast v1.0.0
standards_anchors.use: Keep station classification, spatial interpolation, and elevation/region aggregation as separate evaluation surfaces.

standards_anchors.name: European Avalanche Warning Services danger scale
standards_anchors.use: Preserve five-level danger semantics unless a reviewed mapping justifies aggregation.

standards_anchors.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
standards_anchors.use: Pre-register evaluation and release evidence before any risky operational claim.

standards_anchors.name: ISO 19157 geospatial data quality
standards_anchors.use: Report geospatial completeness, lineage, consistency, and quality in holdout evidence.

standards_anchors.name: FAIR data principles
standards_anchors.use: Keep holdout evidence source-referenced, reusable, and auditable.

stop_conditions: Stop if partner_source_manifest.json is missing or stale.
Stop if independent_himalayan_holdout.csv is missing, blank, or has no independent_holdout rows.
Stop if leakage audit finds source_ref, date, station, region, or scene contamination.
Stop if any acceptance floor is missed; report blocker instead of weakening thresholds.
Stop before production scoring even when the holdout passes; production requires separate release-gate attestations.
